summary.en: A responsive question-and-answer section built from Section and Accordion, with keyboard navigation and one open answer at a time.

en: Browse the workshop questions. Open one answer at a time with a click, Enter or Space; arrow keys move between questions.
This pattern combines Section and Accordion. Supply your own headings and answer content; the shared components provide layout, disclosure state and keyboard handling.

description.en: Open, switch and close answers using the pointer or keyboard.
